# Hoard

> Automatic, versioned game save sync across devices. Hoard watches the folders
> your games save into, snapshots every change, and syncs those snapshots
> between your machines. Steam, GOG, Epic, itch, emulators and 20,000+ games
> from the community save-location manifest. Use the hosted Hoard Cloud, or run
> the same open-source server yourself with no account and no quota.

Free and open source under AGPL-3.0. Windows, Linux, macOS and Steam Deck.
Every session becomes a new version you can roll back to, deduplicated by
content hash so ten versions of a 2 GB save cost about 2 GB, not 20.

Where Hoard is not the answer, and which tool to reach for instead, is laid
out in the comparison guide below.


## Guides

- [How to self-host Hoard with Docker](https://hoard.services/guides/self-host-hoard): Run your own Hoard server with Docker Compose: free, open source, on your hardware, with no account with us and no quota. Your saves stay with you.
- [How to back up your game saves automatically](https://hoard.services/guides/back-up-game-saves): Back up PC game saves automatically after every session, with version history, so a crash, reinstall or bad mod never wipes your progress.
- [How to sync game saves across multiple PCs](https://hoard.services/guides/sync-game-saves-across-pcs): Play on your desktop, laptop and Steam Deck without losing progress: sync game saves between PCs automatically, with version history. Step by step.
- [How to restore an old game save](https://hoard.services/guides/restore-a-game-save): Corrupted save, bad mod or a choice you regret? Roll a game save back to an earlier version, step by step, without losing what's on your PC now.
- [Game save sync compared: Hoard vs Ludusavi, Syncthing, OpenSave and the rest](https://hoard.services/guides/game-save-sync-comparison): Hoard, Ludusavi, Syncthing, OpenSave, GameSave Manager and more compared: what each does best, where each falls short, and a side-by-side table.
- [Ludusavi alternative: automatic cloud sync for your game saves](https://hoard.services/guides/ludusavi-alternative): Ludusavi is great for local backups. Hoard adds automatic sync between PCs and Steam Deck with version history, built on the same save database.
- [How to back up and sync emulator saves (RetroArch, Dolphin, PCSX2)](https://hoard.services/guides/back-up-emulator-saves): Back up and sync emulator saves between PCs and Steam Deck: RetroArch, Dolphin, PCSX2, DuckStation and more, with version history and where each one saves.
- [Steam Cloud alternative: back up the saves Steam doesn't](https://hoard.services/guides/steam-cloud-alternative): Steam Cloud skips many games and keeps no history. Back up every game from any launcher, with versions you can roll back. In the cloud or self-hosted.
- [OpenSave alternative: peer-to-peer or a server you own](https://hoard.services/guides/opensave-alternative): OpenSave syncs saves peer-to-peer; Hoard syncs through a server, ours or yours, and keeps every version. An honest look at when each design wins.
- [Syncthing for game saves: what works and what breaks](https://hoard.services/guides/syncthing-game-saves): Syncthing is a great file syncer, but game saves break three of its assumptions. What goes wrong, the workarounds, and when a save-aware tool fits better.
- [Cyberpunk 2077 save location (PC & Steam Deck)](https://hoard.services/guides/cyberpunk-2077-save-location): Where Cyberpunk 2077 keeps its saves on Windows, Steam Deck and Mac, what each folder holds, and how to back them up or move them between PCs.
- [Crimson Desert save location (PC & Steam Deck)](https://hoard.services/guides/crimson-desert-save-location): Where Crimson Desert keeps its saves on Windows, Steam Deck and Mac, which folder actually holds them, and how to back them up or move them between PCs.
- [Marvel's Spider-Man 2 save location (PC & Steam Deck)](https://hoard.services/guides/spider-man-2-save-location): Where Marvel's Spider-Man 2 keeps its PC saves, what the long-number folder is, the OneDrive trap, the Steam Deck path, and how to back saves up.
- [Baldur's Gate 3 save location (PC & Steam Deck)](https://hoard.services/guides/baldurs-gate-3-save-location): Where Baldur's Gate 3 keeps its saves on Windows, Steam Deck and Mac, what's a save and what's mods or settings, Honour Mode, and how to back saves up.
- [Palworld save location (PC & Steam Deck)](https://hoard.services/guides/palworld-save-location): Where Palworld keeps its worlds on PC and Steam Deck, what each file is, how co-op worlds work, and how to back up your saves or move them between PCs.
